title: Fluu's Teams
description: The bridge between Discord roles and Minecraft teams.
body:
_**In order to use this mod, you MUST invite the Discord bot to your server!**_

Otherwise, the mod will have no way to communicate with Discord!

Please note that this is brand new mod, and I am still new to modding. Any bugs and suggestions should go in the discord: https://discord.gg/WU3zYUKKvP




**How to use this mod?**
1. Invite the bot to your Discord server ( [Click me!](https://discord.com/oauth2/authorize?client_id=1494473660843556884) )

2. Add the mod to your Minecraft server.

3. Go to discord and say $help (The bot will give you instructions on how to properly set up everything!)



_If things are still complicated, please join the Discord server! I'm still debating on whether I should create a YouTube tutorial or not._
